content.title: Trump Administration Waives Biden-Era Fine Against Southwest Airlines
content.summary: Southwest Airlines  is off the hook for an $11 million payment imposed by the Biden administration related to its 2022 holiday meltdown, according to a Transportation Department order issued Friday.  In 2023, after a monthslong investigation, the Biden administration’s DOT issued a civil penalty for Southwest’s violations of consumer protection laws.  Instead, the directive issued Friday gives Southwest a waiver of $11 million.

content.title: Government waives part of a Biden-era fine against Southwest Airlines
content.summary: The U.S. Department of Transportation is waiving part of a fine assessed against Southwest Airlines after the company canceled thousands of flights during a winter storm in 2022.  Under a 2023 settlement reached by the Biden administration, Southwest agreed to a $140 million civil penalty.  The government said at the time that the penalty was the largest it had ever imposed on an airline for violating consumer protection laws.

content.title: SpaceX seeks $800B val., theater stocks fall on Netflix news
content.description:
Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma joins Market Domination host Josh Lipton to discuss some of Friday's trending tickers and stories.

Movie theater stocks, like AMC (AMC), iMax (IMAX), and Cinemark (CNK), are moving lower after Netflix's (NFLX) Warner Bros. (WBD) deal was announced.

SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) is reportedly in talks for $800 billion valuation via a share sale, according to the Wall Street Journal.

Southwest Airlines (LUV) lowered its profit guidance for the full year, citing disruption from the government shutdown.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
